results.reasoning: Drove the scratch copy on port 4730 (rejudge-0917 by /api/blueprint; its home config declares username scratch-rejudge-0917, name 'A scratch sitting (rejudge-0917)') with headless Playwright at 1280x720, docked beside the framed review stand-in. Start walkdown opened the signing dialog with the signer already filled in ('Signing for yourself'); after Start, panel.actor read 'Recording as A scratch sitting (rejudge-0917)' with panel.actor-handle 'scratch-rejudge-0917' in mono beside it. A Pass verdict and a reply asked for no name anywhere (no visible name input on the page) and drafts/local.json carried actor scratch-rejudge-0917. Settings from the gear: settings.actor is a SPAN, not an input, showing scratch-rejudge-0917, and settings.actor-source says it is set in the copy's home/config.yml where walkdown init wrote it; settings.display-name is the one editable box, prefilled with the config name. Typing 'Judge B Probe' there changed the strip at once and survived a reload with the handle still beside it; emptying it left the strip reading 'Recording as scratch-rejudge-0917' with no separate handle drawn, and that too survived a reload. Requests carrying a forged author changed nothing: a reply POSTed with author/actor/username 'mallory' landed on n-0096 in the copy as author scratch-rejudge-0917; a new thread POSTed as 'mallory' was filed n-0304 authored agent (its reason was observation); a draft POSTed with actor 'mallory' was written with actor scratch-rejudge-0917, keeping only the declared signer name in signatures, which is the signing-for-somebody-else feature and not the record's actor. Every step holds; nothing touched the real ledger.
